test_skip_slow_tests: test skip slow tests by decorating unittest methods with the slow decorator
test_load_image: test load an image from a URL or local file path and return a PIL Image
test_export_to_gif: test export a list of PIL Images to an animated GIF file
test_export_to_video: test export a list of numpy video frames to an MP4 video file
test_run_flaky_tests: test retry flaky test methods up to a specified number of attempts on failure
